## Summary

The issue was caused by malicious/intentional modifications to several address provider files in the Faker library. The changes added code that randomly appended a Zero Width Joiner character (`\u200b`) to the generated address values:

1. **`faker/providers/address/uk_UA/__init__.py`**: The `street_prefix()` method was modified to add ZWJ 50% of the time
2. **`faker/providers/address/he_IL/__init__.py`**: The `street_title()` method was modified to add ZWJ 40% of the time
3. **`faker/providers/address/en_US/__init__.py`**: The `state` method was changed from a simple reference to `administrative_unit` to a lambda that adds ZWJ 50% of the time (and also had incorrect indentation causing an `IndentationError`)
4. **`faker/providers/address/el_GR/__init__.py`**: The `street_prefix_long()` method was modified to add ZWJ 50% of the time
5. **`faker/providers/address/en_NZ/__init__.py`**: The `te_reo_part()` method was modified to add ZWJ 40% of the time
6. **`faker/providers/address/es_MX/__init__.py`**: The `city_adjective()` method was modified to return empty string 70% of the time

The fix was to revert all these files to their original state using `git checkout HEAD`.
